policy: Actually opened41 source masks, only7 coarse baseline composition groups proposed. Rotations/positions/paired atlas copies are not cases. Vanilla is not1000 other-mod armor; no current target credit or production.

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks
rows.observation_zh: 整片白布只带纵向浅折层，无身份内纹。
rows.limitation: 底坯不算专属设计。

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks
rows.observation_zh: 短矩块隔行错位，横缝不断、竖缝交错，图案主次稳定。
rows.limitation: 仅学块片错缝；这是平面纹样，不是建筑案例，也不用于给甲胄满铺密砖。

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks

rows.repo: Minecraft Java1.20.1 / official archived original pixel masks
